sloka: महाब्रह्मर्षिसृष्टा वा ज्वलन्तो भीमदर्शना ।धिग्वाग्दण्डणा न हिम्सन्ति रामप्रव्राजने स्थिताम् ॥२-३५-१५॥
transliteration: mahābrahmarṣisṛṣṭā vā jvalanto bhīmadarśanā ।dhigvāgdaṇḍaṇā na himsanti rāmapravrājane sthitām ॥2-35-15॥

translations.english: It is a wonder that while bent upon banishing Rama, you are not destroyed by frightening fire created by great brahmarsis, crying, 'Shame, shame'
